'''Yurtoln''' was a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Overseer (Sith)|Overseer]] of the [[Sith Academy (Korriban)|Sith Academy]] on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]]. Decades before the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], Yurtoln trained a [[Shyrack/Legends|shyrack]] and set the creature on his [[Sith acolyte/Legends|acolytes]]. Several years later, the shyrack turned on Yurtoln and plucked out his [[Eye/Legends|eye]] before the Overseer killed the creature. He then had the shyrack's body preserved and kept it as a trophy out of respect for the creature.<ref name="TOR Encyclopedia" />
